description: Returns a property matched by Assessor's Parcel Number (APN), with optional location narrowing and contacts. APN formatting is normalized automatically. A matched property costs one property credit; returned contacts can consume people credits.

contact_audience.description: `none` returns property-only data with zero people credits; other values include matching contacts

fields.description: DealMachine property field IDs to include in results

location.description: Optional location to narrow results, including a city place ID

code.description: State abbreviation, ZIP code, county FIPS, or numeric city place ID

name: dealmachine_enrich_apn
